Chamfer2.what: wrong edges: tub2_tab.key_sketch chamfers all 4 corners of the key-tab rectangle by SKIN (1.0); SW chamfers 2 corners per side (one 45 deg top-front, one along the sloped lug face, n=(-0.93,0.36))
Chamfer2.cause: chamfer on wrong edge set (assumed symmetric octagon)
Chamfer2.fix: tool: chamfer finder that reports which corners of a section carry a bevel (not just the size); guide: never generalise a blend to all corners of a sketch without seeing each one

Boss-Extrude6.what: wrong section: tub2_lobes.lobe = hull(circle R4.5 at nut, circle R2 at LOBE_CAP (0.5, 6.9)); SW Sketch12 is lines + the R4.5 and R2 arcs with two tangent sloped edges (n=(-0.33,0.94), (0.08,1.0)) and the slit cut in the same sketch
Boss-Extrude6.fix: tool: sketch extractor (STEP section normal to the boss axis, fit lines/arcs, report tangency) ; guide: build a boss outline from its own section, not a convex hull of guessed circles

Mirror7.what: the -X copy of Boss-Extrude6 + Fillet7: same 0.18 mm error mirrored
Mirror7.fix: check: per-feature face offset map (a mirrored copy repeats the error of its seed, and one global IoU hides it)

Fillet7.what: radius right (SLIT_R 0.5) but on a measured point table: tub2_lobes.SLIT = 4 (Y,Z) points read off the STEP
Fillet7.fix: guide: no measured coordinate tables; a slit is a sketch with dims + relations; tool: sketch extractor returns dims, not points

Fillet12.what: cavity corner R1.5 (tub2_params.CAVITY_R = 3*SKIN/2) where SW has R1 (Fillet12, 4 vertical cavity corners)
Fillet12.cause: fillet wrong radius (radius derived from a relation, not measured)
Fillet12.fix: tool: fillet radius finder on STEP sections (concave corner arcs) ; guide: a radius written as a formula of a master must be checked against a measured r

Fillet13.what: deck-pocket corners R2: 8 of 12 faces match, the 4 short arcs near the X-rib ends are 0.16 off (pocket outline vertex 0.16 mm from SW)
Fillet13.fix: check: per-feature face offset map at 0.05 mm (reference_cad.diff tol 1.0 is 6x too coarse)

Fillet20.what: rear box corners R1.5 (tub2_params.REAR_R) where SW has R1 (Fillet20)
Fillet20.fix: tool: fillet radius finder on STEP sections ; check: dump-free fillet radius parity (visual.fillet_ref) on every concave corner

Cut-Extrude6.what: hex nut pocket 0.15 off: ours is a catalogue hex (AF 5.5, corners up), SW sketch is its own polygon (D1 depth 2)
Cut-Extrude6.cause: catalogue part substituted for the drawn sketch
Cut-Extrude6.fix: guide: a pocket's size comes from the drawn section (clearance included), not from the nut catalogue

Mirror8.what: -X copy of Cut-Extrude6, same 0.15; the waiver on +X does not cover it
Mirror8.cause: catalogue part substituted for the drawn sketch
Mirror8.fix: check: per-feature face offset map at 0.05 mm

Cut-Extrude9.what: N10 keyhole opened into a U-slot (design change, waived)

extra:1.what: +X front deck corner: the 2 mm deck chamfer (Chamfer3) turns the 45 deg corner as a blended 'surf' face; ours leaves 1.1 mm of material there
extra:1.fix: tool: chamfer finder that follows the chamfer round plan corners ; check: sample dump 'surf' faces too (sldprt_dump.face_samples skips them, so dump.fillet is blind here)

extra:2.fix: tool: chamfer finder that follows the chamfer round plan corners

extra:4.what: -X only, under the deck at the rear corner block (Z 17.3-17.5), 0.5 mm proud; no +X counterpart, so it is an asymmetric leftover of a -X-first boolean
extra:4.fix: check: mirror symmetry of a part declared symmetric (diff the part with its own mirror)

Chamfer2.what: N10 preload pad top chamfer 0.25 (panel_base.PAD_CHAMFER = the whole pad height) where SW has 0.4 x 45 deg; the pad height was changed to preload the N10 and the chamfer shrunk with it
Chamfer2.cause: chamfer wrong size (follows an altered feature)
Chamfer2.fix: guide: when a design change alters a feature, keep the designer's blend sizes and record the change as a deviation, not silently ; check: blend size parity in sections (tool: chamfer finder)

Boss-Extrude1.what: outline ears R2.6 at the CSK holes (waived: M2 head seat)

Chamfer1.what: CSK seat 4.5 instead of SW 0.5 chamfer (waived)

Fillet1.what: skin-to-ring-step R1 (WG_STEP_FILLET) only on outline lines longer than WG_STEP_MIN 8 mm; SW fillets the whole edge chain, 0.52 mm off on the short segments
Fillet1.fix: tool: fillet finder that returns the whole tangent edge chain ; guide: select blend edges by chain, never by a length threshold

Cut-Extrude16.what: cut outline from the measured (Y,Z) point tables in params_side (WG_IN_SLOT / WG_CHEEK); 0.13 mm off
Cut-Extrude16.fix: tool: sketch extractor (lines/arcs + relations from STEP sections) ; guide: no measured coordinate tables

Cut-Extrude20.what: slot from measured point table, 0.44 mm off
Cut-Extrude20.fix: tool: sketch extractor (lines/arcs + relations from STEP sections) ; guide: no measured coordinate tables
